blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Police in Northern Mindanao arrested 145 suspects and seized P6.7 million worth of alleged illicit goods in the past week, an official said. The coordinated crackdown, mounted by Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) from September 10 to 16, cut across a wide illicit landscape: narcotics, smuggled goods, illegal mining, underground gambling, and fugitives on the run. The biggest strike hit the drug pipeline with 65 separate anti-narcotics operations netting 65 suspects and 590.497 grams of suspected shabu, with an estimated value of P4,015,257.
